summary: Fuse the M2.6 Q4_K_M dequant front-end onto the M3.3c register-blocked coopmat matmul. Each workgroup cooperatively dequantizes a tile of Q4_K_M weights into a shared[f16] tile (via a NEW f32_to_f16 builtin), stages the f16 activation tile into shared, barriers, then runs the M3.3c 2x2 register-blocked coopmat K-loop (4 loop-carried accumulators, A/B reuse, OpPhi) over the dequantized f16 tiles and coopmat_stores the output. This lifts AXIOM's Q4_K_M throughput from the FROZEN single-row matvec (~0.000085 TFLOPS, M3.4) toward the generic f16 RB matmul's throughput, then RE-RUNS the M3.4 A/B vs llama.cpp Vulkan Q4_K_M — but on a SAME-SHAPE basis (CRITICAL-1 fix): AXIOM fused GEMM at (m=4096,n=512,k=14336) vs llama.cpp Q4_K MUL_MAT at the IDENTICAL shape (101.00 TFLOPS, llamacpp_raw.txt:174). The HONEST expected result is AXIOM ~10-25 TFLOPS vs llama 101 → ~4-10x BEHIND same-shape — a massive improvement from M3.4's ~87,000x but STILL behind, reported as that. The single real language gap is the f32->f16 conversion (the dequant arithmetic is f32, coopmat tiles are f16); AXIOM lacks it today (SharedWrite of an f32 into shared[f16] is a HARD ERROR via SharedWriteTypeMismatch, typecheck.rs:3541), so M3.5 adds a bounded f32_to_f16 builtin lowering to OpFConvert f32->f16 (RNE) under the ALREADY-DECLARED Float16 capability (NO new capability beyond the M3.3c+M2.6 union). The correctness oracle (CRITICAL-2 fix) accumulates the CPU reference in f16 to MATCH the GPU's CONFIRMED f16 coopmat accumulator (matmul_rb_coopmat.axc:122-125), with a measured gate-K policy and separate larger-K error reporting; the frozen 1e-3 is NOT loosened.

technical_spec:
## M3.5 — Q4_K_M dequant fused into the register-blocked coopmat matmul (r1)

### 0. The KEY language question: f32 -> f16 (RESOLVED) + the capability baseline (CORRECTED)

The Q4_K_M dequant produces f32: `f16_bits_to_f32` widens the f16 super-scale/min to f32 (q4_0.rs:145, OpFConvert f16->f32), `f32_from_u32` converts the 6-bit scales and 4-bit nibbles to f32, and all dequant arithmetic (`d1*nib - m1f`, etc.) is f32 (q4km_dequant_matmul.axc:84-96). But the coopmat tiles are `shared[f16, N]`. Writing an f32 value into a `shared[f16]` element is a HARD ERROR today: `check_index_assign_stmt` typechecks the RHS against the shared elem type and pushes `SharedWriteTypeMismatch` when `value_hir.ty != elem_ty` (typecheck.rs:3538-3548). There is NO implicit conversion (anti-pattern #1). AXIOM has `f16_bits_to_f32` and `f32_from_u32` but NO `f32_to_f16`. So a NEW builtin is required.

**Decision: add `f32_to_f16(x: f32) -> f16` as a 5th variant of the existing Q4_0Builtin family.** Lowering: `OpFConvert %f16 %f32` (single instruction, IEEE round-to-nearest-even — the SPIR-V default rounding for OpFConvert; no FPRoundingMode decoration needed and none is used elsewhere in codegen). This is the EXACT inverse of the existing `emit_f16_bits_to_f32`'s final OpFConvert step.

**Capability baseline (CORRECTED per pessimistic review).** The f32_to_f16 builtin itself needs ONLY `Float16` (caps.float16=true), already declared by every coopmat-f16 kernel (emit.rs:360-365) and shared[f16] (shared.rs:120). BUT the fused kernel as a WHOLE is NOT a subset of matmul_rb_coopmat.axc's caps: the `q: readonly_buffer[u8]` weight buffer pulls in `Int8` + `StorageBuffer8BitAccess` + `SPV_KHR_8bit_storage` via `emit_ptr_read_u8_zext` (q4_0.rs:49-50, sets caps.int8=true + caps.storage_8bit=true) — these are absent from matmul_rb_coopmat.axc but PRESENT in the FROZEN M2.6 q4km_dequant_matmul.axc. So the no-new-capability proof's baseline is the UNION of the M3.3c coopmat caps AND the M2.6 Q4_K_M dequant caps. AT-1773 asserts the emitted module declares NO capability/extension beyond that union; f32_to_f16 contributes NOTHING new to it (Float16 already in the union). The earlier r0 claim 'no capability absent from matmul_rb_coopmat.axc' was FALSE and is corrected here.

Why a Q4_0Builtin variant rather than a fresh family: every layer already routes the Q4_0Builtin set — lexer emits a plain Ident, parser builds Expr::Call (no grammar change), `Q4_0Builtin::from_source_name` (q4_0.rs:70) dispatches the call (typecheck.rs:3374), the HIR node `HirExprKind::Q4_0Builtin { op, args }` (expr.rs:188) already carries the op, body.rs:1490-1550 dispatches codegen, and `is_reserved_q4_0_builtin` (q4_0.rs:127) auto-reserves the new name. The addition is bounded: one enum variant + 4 match arms + one SORTED RESERVED name + one typecheck arm + one codegen emit helper + one body.rs dispatch arm.

**Alternative considered and REJECTED: dequant directly in f16.** ggml dequantizes Q4_K to f32 (the reference IS f32 dequant). f16 intermediate dequant arithmetic would diverge MORE from ggml. The numerically-correct path is: dequant in f32 EXACTLY as ggml/M2.6 does, then a SINGLE f32->f16 rounding at the tile write (the only precision loss forced by the f16 tile format). So f32_to_f16 is both the minimal language addition AND the numerically-correct choice.

### 1. The fused kernel (examples/q4km_matmul_rb_coopmat.axc)

Structure = M3.3c matmul_rb_coopmat.axc with the A-tile staging replaced by a Q4_K_M dequant->f16 stage. @workgroup(32,1,1) = 1 subgroup; one workgroup computes a 2x2 block of 16x16 output tiles (32x32 C sub-tile). Grid = (N/32, M/32, 1). Buffers: `q: readonly_buffer[u8]` (Q4_K_M weights, the A matrix, 144-byte superblocks per HN-11 row-major layout), `x: readonly_buffer[f16]` (the activation/B matrix, already f16), `C: buffer[f16]` output. M=rows of weights, N=cols of x, K=contraction = n_blocks_per_row*256.

**Per K-block body:**
1. **Dequant A tile -> shared[f16].** The 32x16 A block (RB_M*16 rows x tile_k=16 cols) for this k_block is dequantized cooperatively across the 32 lanes. tile_k=16 < 256 (one superblock = 256 weights = 16 K-blocks of 16), so the dequant addresses a 16-wide K-slice within a superblock. The mapping (Q4_K_M-superblock-to-tile): for a target (a_row in 0..32, a_col in 0..16) the global weight index is row=block_row*32+a_row, k = k_block*16 + a_col; superblock sb = k / 256, within-superblock index wk = k - sb*256; chunk = wk / 64; within-chunk = wk - chunk*64; element l = within-chunk % 32; nibble = lo if within-chunk<32 else hi; sub-block is = chunk*2 + (within-chunk>=32 ? 1 : 0). The inline get_scale_min_k4 + d/dmin loads + nibble dequant are the byte-identical M2.6/q4km_dequant_matmul.axc logic (lines 41-104). The resulting f32 weight is converted: `let w: f16 = f32_to_f16(d1 * f32_from_u32(nib) - m1f); a_tile[ei_a] = w;`. The cooperative staging loop is the M3.3c a_iter loop (ei_a = a_iter*32 + lane). STAGING COVERAGE: each a_tile element (ei_a, 16 iters x 32 lanes = 512 elements) is written EXACTLY ONCE — asserted in AT-1770/1771 (AT-1620 class).
2. **Stage B (x) tile -> shared[f16].** x is already f16, so this is the verbatim M3.3c b_iter staging loop: `b_tile[ei_b] = x[b_global];` (no conversion).
3. **workgroup_barrier()** (staging complete).
4. **coopmat loads + 4 mul_adds** — verbatim M3.3c: a_mat_0/a_mat_1 from a_tile, b_mat_0/b_mat_1 from b_tile, 4 loop-carried accumulators acc_00/01/10/11 (CONFIRMED `matrix[f16,16,16,accumulator]`, matmul_rb_coopmat.axc:122-125) reassigned unconditionally (N-phi path, AT-1733). A/B reuse preserved.
5. **workgroup_barrier()** (WAR before next k_block overwrites tiles).

**Post K-loop:** coopmat_store the 4 accumulators to C (verbatim M3.3c output addressing).

@strategy holes rb_m/rb_n/tile_k/a_block_size/b_block_size are GENUINELY used. tile_k MUST be 16 (coopmat K dim). Shared total = (512+512)*2 = 2048 bytes << maxComputeSharedMemorySize (49152 on the device, llamacpp_raw.txt:2); the maxComputeSharedMemorySize preflight (M3.2 CRITICAL-4) gates it.

### 2. Numerics + the correctness oracle (NON-NEGOTIABLE, f16-accumulator-MATCHED)

The fused kernel is NOT bit-exact vs the f32 matvec/matmul path. Three precision losses, ALL intrinsic to the f16 tensor-core path: (a) each dequantized f32 weight is rounded to f16 at the tile write (f32_to_f16); (b) the activation x is f16 input; (c) the coopmat accumulator is CONFIRMED f16 (matmul_rb_coopmat.axc:122-125, `matrix[f16, 16, 16, accumulator]`) — accumulation precision is the device's coopmat f16 result type.

**CRITICAL-2 FIX — the oracle MATCHES the GPU accumulator.** The r0 oracle accumulated the CPU reference in f32, which is NOT a tight bound on an f16-accumulator kernel (summing K=512..14336 f16 products in f16 diverges from f32 accumulation). The r1 oracle (common_q4km_f16ref.rs::q4km_dequant_matmul_f16accum_cpu) instead ACCUMULATES IN f16 to MATCH the GPU: dequantize EXACTLY as ggml/M2.6 (f32), round each weight AND each x activation f32->f16->f32 (half-crate exact RNE round-trip, matching OpFConvert RNE), then walk K in depth-16 coopmat tiles, accumulate each 16-deep partial and round the running accumulator to f16 after each tile add (mirroring the f16 coopmat accumulator's per-tile rounding). Compare the GPU f16 output (widened to f32) vs this reference within the FROZEN rel_tol = 1e-3 (the AT-1520 M2.6 Q4_K_M value and AT-1521 f16 coopmat bridge value). The 1e-3 is NOT loosened to absorb accumulator error.

**Gate-K policy (CRITICAL-2 / OQ-2 resolved).** The within-tol gate is asserted ONLY at the K where 1e-3 provably holds against this f16-accumulator reference — MEASURED, not asserted. AT-1770 (K=256, 1 superblock = 16 tile_k K-blocks) and AT-1771 (K=512, 2 superblocks = 32 tile_k K-blocks) measure the max-rel-diff and assert <=1e-3 at those K. The bench (AT-1772) runs to larger K (768/1024) and REPORTS the measured max-rel-diff at every size WITHOUT gating it; if a larger K exceeds 1e-3 that is reported HONESTLY (it would motivate an f32-accumulator coopmat shape, a future milestone) — it is NOT hidden and does NOT relax the gate. The f16-accumulator within-tol result is NVIDIA-coopmat-accumulator-SPECIFIC (a different vendor's strict-f16 accumulator may differ), not a portable guarantee — documented.

The dequant correctness itself is the FROZEN, separately-proven M2.6 logic (AT-1520 bit-exact, AT-1761 rel_err 1.2e-7); the M3.5 oracle additionally proves the dequant->f16->f16-accumulator-coopmat bridge end-to-end. Both the dequant AND the matmul are verified. The measured max-rel-diff is REPORTED at every size (not just pass/fail) so the headroom under 1e-3 is visible.

### 3. The M3.4 A/B RE-RUN (the fair fight — SAME-SHAPE, CRITICAL-1 FIX)

Same methodology as M3.4 (scripts/m34_llamacpp_ab.sh): same machine, same nvidia_icd.json, kernel-only-vs-kernel-only, device-match fail-closed (byte-identical device strings), FLOP-consistency check (2*m*n*k MACs, dequant excluded, BOTH sides), SHA-pinned llama.cpp b9542/6b80c74.

**The kill-criterion-of-record is SAME-SHAPE (CRITICAL-1).** M3.4 honestly compared llama's n==1 GEMV against AXIOM's single-row matvec (BOTH low-intensity GEMV — a fair same-shape fight that AXIOM lost ~87,000x). M3.5's fused kernel is a GEMM; comparing AXIOM's fused GEMM against llama's n==1 GEMV would be apples-to-oranges in ARITHMETIC INTENSITY, not just shape, and would FLATTER AXIOM by ~13.7x. The pinned data proves it: the IDENTICAL llama Q4_K MUL_MAT kernel runs 7.39 TFLOPS at n=1 (llamacpp_raw.txt:24) vs 101.00 TFLOPS at n=512 (llamacpp_raw.txt:174). Headlining AXIOM-GEMM (~10-25 TFLOPS, OQ-4 estimate) vs llama-n1-GEMV (7.39) would print 'AXIOM ahead' — exactly the reward-hacked, intent-laundered claim the thesis exists to prevent.

**Therefore:**
  - **HEADLINE / kill-criterion-of-record = SAME-SHAPE GEMM-vs-GEMM:** AXIOM fused GEMM at (m=4096, n=512, k=14336) vs llama.cpp Q4_K MUL_MAT at the IDENTICAL (m=4096, n=512, k=14336) = 101.00 TFLOPS (the pinned same-shape line). m34_emit.py computes the headline ratio = axc_fused_tflops / 101.00 and the within-15% kill-criterion verdict FROM THIS. HONEST expected result: AXIOM ~10-25 TFLOPS / 101 → AXIOM ~4-10x BEHIND same-shape. This is a MASSIVE improvement from M3.4's ~87,000x but STILL BEHIND, and is reported as exactly that — NOT spun as a win. The NVIDIA kill-criterion (within 15%) does NOT fire (AXIOM is behind); reported honestly.
  - **CROSS-SHAPE CONTEXT (labeled, NEVER the headline):** the n==1 GEMV boundary (AXIOM matvec/GEMM TFLOPS vs llama n=1=7.39) MAY appear in a clearly-labeled 'cross_shape_context' block annotated 'cross-shape, NOT the kill criterion — llama's n=1 is memory-bound GEMV at 13.7x lower intensity than its own n=512 GEMM'. It documents the M3.4-successor data point and how far the gap collapsed, but is never the within-15% input nor the headline ratio.

emit.py computes the ratio from the fused kernel's ACTUAL FLOPs (2*M*N*K). Recorded in ab_results_fused.json with the SAME fail-closed discipline (device-match, FLOP-consistency, SHA-pin). HONESTY clause: if dequant overhead makes the fused kernel ALU-bound and even further behind 101 TFLOPS, that is reported as the result — no cherry-picking, no shape-swapping to flatter.

### 4. What is FROZEN / unchanged

q4km_dequant_matvec.axc (M2.6) and matmul_rb_coopmat.axc (M3.3c) are NOT modified. AT-1520, AT-1730/1731/1732/1733, AT-1760..1767 stay green. The M3.4 frozen-matvec A/B (ab_results.json) is retained as the regression baseline; the fused SAME-SHAPE A/B is a NEW artifact (ab_results_fused.json). The frozen 1e-3 tolerance is preserved.

## 3.1.20 M3.5 — Q4_K_M dequant fused into the register-blocked coopmat matmul (closing the M3.4 gap, SAME-SHAPE)

M3.4 (§3.1.19) measured the FROZEN M2.6 single-row Q4_K_M matvec at ~0.000085 TFLOPS = ~87,000x slower than llama.cpp Vulkan Q4_K_M — but that was an HONEST same-shape GEMV-vs-GEMV loss (both sides n==1, 7.39 TFLOPS on the llama side). M3.3c (§3.1.17) reached 31.2 TFLOPS (24.96% of the 125-TFLOPS datasheet estimate) with a GENERIC f16 register-blocked coopmat matmul. M3.5 FUSES them: a Q4_K_M matmul that dequantizes a tile of weights into a shared[f16] tile then runs the M3.3c RB coopmat K-loop.

**The f32->f16 builtin (the single language gap).** The dequant produces f32 (f16_bits_to_f32 widens scales/mins; all dequant arithmetic is f32 — matching ggml's f32 dequant). The coopmat tiles are shared[f16]. Writing f32 into shared[f16] is a HARD ERROR (SharedWriteTypeMismatch; no coercion, anti-pattern #1) and AXIOM had no f32->f16. M3.5 adds f32_to_f16(x: f32) -> f16 as a 5th Q4_0Builtin variant lowering to a single OpFConvert f32->f16 (IEEE RNE, the SPIR-V default; no FPRoundingMode decoration). The builtin needs ONLY Float16 (already declared). The fused kernel's readonly_buffer[u8] weight buffer additionally pulls in Int8/StorageBuffer8BitAccess/SPV_KHR_8bit_storage — these are the FROZEN M2.6 Q4_K_M dequant caps, NOT new; so AT-1773's no-new-capability baseline is the UNION of the M3.3c coopmat caps and the M2.6 Q4_K_M dequant caps, and f32_to_f16 adds nothing beyond that union.

**The fused kernel (q4km_matmul_rb_coopmat.axc).** @workgroup(32,1,1), grid (N/32, M/32, 1), one workgroup = a 2x2 block of 16x16 output tiles. Per K-block: cooperatively dequantize the 32x16 A-block from Q4_K_M (the byte-identical M2.6 inline get_scale_min_k4 + nibble path, q4km_dequant_matmul.axc:41-104), convert `let w: f16 = f32_to_f16(...); a_tile[ei]=w;` (each a_tile element written exactly once, AT-1620-class coverage asserted); stage the f16 x B-tile (no conversion); barrier; M3.3c 4-accumulator A/B-reuse coopmat mul_adds (matrix[f16,16,16,accumulator], N-phi loop-carried); WAR barrier; after K, coopmat_store.

**Numerics + oracle (f16-accumulator-MATCHED).** NOT bit-exact vs the f32 path. The GPU coopmat accumulator is f16 (matmul_rb_coopmat.axc:122-125); the CPU oracle MATCHES that — dequant in f32 exactly as ggml, round weights+x f32->f16->f32 (RNE), then accumulate in f16 (round the running accumulator to f16 after each depth-16 tile add). Validated within the FROZEN @equiv_fp_tol(1e-3) (AT-1520/AT-1521 value, NOT loosened). The within-tol gate is asserted at the MEASURED provably-1e-3 K (AT-1770 K=256, AT-1771 K=512); larger-K max-rel-diff is reported SEPARATELY and the measured max-rel-diff is reported at EVERY size. The f16-accumulator within-tol result is NVIDIA-coopmat-accumulator-specific.

**Measured TFLOPS (AT-1772) — HONEST, no asserted ratio.** resident_q4km_matmul_rb.rs (M3.3c methodology) at 256/512/768(/1024) + the pinned A/B shape. Reports bare tflops + % of 125-TFLOPS + measured max-rel-diff; 'competitive' label only if pct>=25.0. Expected BELOW M3.3c's 31.2 TFLOPS (Q4_K_M dequant is ALU-heavy). [Coder fills the measured table.]

**The M3.4 A/B re-run (AT-1774) — SAME-SHAPE, the fair fight.** scripts/m34_llamacpp_ab.sh --fused: same machine/ICD/SHA (b9542/6b80c74), device-match byte-identical, FLOP-consistency (2*m*n*k, dequant excluded both sides), kernel-only. The HEADLINE / kill-criterion-of-record is SAME-SHAPE: AXIOM fused GEMM at (m=4096,n=512,k=14336) vs llama.cpp Q4_K MUL_MAT at the IDENTICAL shape = 101.00 TFLOPS. Honest expected result: AXIOM ~10-25 TFLOPS vs llama 101 → AXIOM ~4-10x BEHIND same-shape — a MASSIVE improvement from M3.4's ~87,000x but STILL behind, reported as that (NOT a win). The n==1 GEMV (llama 7.39 TFLOPS) appears ONLY as labeled cross-shape context — the SAME llama kernel runs 13.7x faster at n=512 than n=1, so headlining AXIOM-GEMM vs llama-n1-GEMV would flatter AXIOM ~13x (the inverse of M3.4's honest GEMV-vs-GEMV loss, and exactly the intent-laundered claim the thesis forbids). Kill-criterion verdict (DESIGN §5, within 15%): does NOT fire (AXIOM behind same-shape); reported honestly. Recorded in ab_results_fused.json. HONESTY: if dequant dominates and AXIOM is further behind 101, that is the reported result.

*(Changelog: M3.5 — f32_to_f16 builtin (5th Q4_0Builtin variant, OpFConvert f32->f16 RNE, Float16-only, no capability beyond the M3.3c+M2.6 union) + the fused Q4_K_M register-blocked coopmat matmul (dequant->shared[f16]->M3.3c RB coopmat); within the FROZEN 1e-3 vs an f16-ACCUMULATOR-matched ggml Q4_K_M reference (AT-1770/1771, measured max-rel-diff reported, gate-K capped at the provably-1e-3 K); honest multi-size TFLOPS + max-rel-diff (AT-1772); CI no-new-capability-beyond-union anchor (AT-1773); the M3.4 A/B RE-RUN with the fused kernel SAME-SHAPE (AT-1774, ab_results_fused.json) — AXIOM ~4-10x behind llama's same-shape 101 TFLOPS, down from M3.4's ~87,000x cross-shape; f32_to_f16 layer + codegen unit coverage (AT-1775/1776). FROZEN M2.6 matvec + M3.3c RB matmul + M3.4 matvec A/B + 1e-3 tolerance unchanged. AT-1770..AT-1776.)*
